meta.name: dbt-snapshots
meta.description: Load when task involves dbt snapshots, SCD Type 2, or tracking data changes over time. Covers strategy selection, column casing, verification, and common pitfalls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理数据变更历史，追踪维度表随时间的变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在数据仓库中记录维度属性的历史变化
copy.tagline_en: Manage data change history and track dimension table changes over time
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track historical changes in dimension tables in your data warehouse

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你创建和管理 dbt 快照（SCD Type 2），包括选择合适的策略（timestamp 或 check）、正确配置列大小写、编写快照 SQL、运行验证以及下游模型引用。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 dbt 快照、SCD Type 2 或跟踪数据随时间变化时触发。

say.text: 帮我在dbt中创建一个SCD Type 2快照，跟踪员工表的变化。
say.note: Claude会指导你编写快照文件并选择策略。

say.text: 检查这个快照是否检测到了数据变化。
say.note: Claude会解释验证查询和零变化的情况。

say.text: 引用快照中的最新数据行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create and manage dbt snapshots (SCD Type 2), including strategy selection (timestamp or check), correct column casing, writing snapshot SQL, verification, and downstream model references.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves dbt snapshots, SCD Type 2, or tracking data changes over time.

say_en.text: Create a SCD Type 2 snapshot for the employees table.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through writing the snapshot file and choosing a strategy.

say_en.text: Check if this snapshot detected any changes.
say_en.note: Claude will explain verification queries and zero-change scenarios.

say_en.text: Reference the latest version of each row from the snapshot.
say_en.note: Claude will show you how to filter with dbt_valid_to IS NULL.
